name: tap-ai
description: Tap AI -- a lightweight, governed way for subject-matter experts to contribute business context into the systems that depend on it.

scripts.setup: npm run seeds:build && npm run db:build && npm run export:decisions
scripts.verify: python3 scripts/verify.py && python3 scripts/tone_audit.py && python3 scripts/drift_check.py
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run verify
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:site
